entities.summary: Pamela Geller is an American anti-Muslim, far-right political activist, blogger and commentator. Geller promoted birther conspiracy theories about President Barack Obama, saying that he was born in Kenya and that he is a Muslim. Pamela Geller was a performers & entertainers from Long Island (b. 1958-06-14, Long Island). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
